#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <cassert>

using namespace std;

class NumberTheory {
public:
    class Modulus {
    public:
        vector<long long> factorial;
        vector<long long> invFactorial;

        Modulus() {
            factorial.push_back(1LL);
            invFactorial.push_back(1LL);
        }

        virtual long long modulus() const = 0;

        long long fact(int n) {
            while ((int)factorial.size() <= n) {
                factorial.push_back(mult(factorial.back(), (long long)factorial.size()));
            }
            return factorial[n];
        }

        long long fInv(int n) {
            int lastKnown = (int)invFactorial.size() - 1;
            if (lastKnown < n) {
                vector<long long> fInv(n - lastKnown);
                fInv[0] = inv(fact(n));
                for (int i = 1; i < (int)fInv.size(); i++) {
                    fInv[i] = mult(fInv[i - 1], n - i + 1);
                }
                for (int i = (int)fInv.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                    invFactorial.push_back(fInv[i]);
                }
            }
            return invFactorial[n];
        }

        long long paritySign(long long k) const {
            return (k & 1) == 0 ? 1LL : modulus() - 1LL;
        }

        long long ncr(int n, int r) {
            assert(n >= 0);
            if (r < 0 || n < r)
                return 0;
            return mult(fact(n), mult(fInv(r), fInv(n - r)));
        }

        long long normalize(long long x) const {
            x %= modulus();
            if (x < 0)
                x += modulus();
            return x;
        }

        long long add(long long a, long long b) const {
            long long v = a + b;
            return v < modulus() ? v : v - modulus();
        }

        long long mult(long long a, long long b) const {
            return (a * b) % modulus();
        }

        long long mult(const vector<long long>& x) const {
            long long r = 1;
            for (auto i : x)
                r = mult(r, i);
            return r;
        }

        long long pow(long long x, int e) const {
            if (e < 0) {
                x = inv(x);
                e = -e;
            }
            long long result = 1;
            long long base = x;
            while (e > 0) {
                if (e & 1)
                    result = mult(result, base);
                base = mult(base, base);
                e >>= 1;
            }
            return result;
        }

        long long inv(long long value) const {
            long long g = modulus(), x = 0, y = 1;
            long long r = value;
            while (r != 0) {
                long long q = g / r;
                long long temp = g % r;
                g = r;
                r = temp;

                temp = x;
                x = y - q * x;
                y = temp;
            }
            assert(g == 1);
            assert(y == modulus() || y == -modulus());
            return normalize(x);
        }
    };

    class Mod998 : public Modulus {
    public:
        long long modulus() const override {
            return 998244353LL;
        }
    };
};

class InputReader {
public:
    istream& in;
    string buffer;
    size_t pos;

    InputReader(istream& stream) : in(stream), pos(0) {}

    string next() {
        while (true) {
            if (pos >= buffer.size()) {
                getline(in, buffer);
                pos = 0;
                if (in.fail()) {
                    throw runtime_error("Input failure");
                }
            }
            if (!buffer.empty()) {
                size_t start = buffer.find_first_not_of(' ', pos);
                if (start == string::npos) {
                    buffer.clear();
                    continue;
                }
                size_t end = buffer.find(' ', start);
                if (end == string::npos) {
                    end = buffer.size();
                }
                string token = buffer.substr(start, end - start);
                pos = end;
                return token;
            }
        }
    }

    int nextInt() {
        return stoi(next());
    }

    long long nextLong() {
        return stoll(next());
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    InputReader in(cin);
    NumberTheory::Mod998 mod;

    int n = in.nextInt();
    long long k = in.nextLong();

    if (k == 0) {
        cout << mod.fact(n) << "\n";
        return 0;
    }

    if (k > n - 1) {
        cout << 0 << "\n";
        return 0;
    }

    int c = n - (int)k;

    long long answer = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= c; i++) {
        long long term = mod.mult({mod.paritySign(c - i), mod.ncr(c, i), mod.pow(i, n)});
        answer = mod.add(answer, term);
    }

    long long total = mod.mult({answer, 2, mod.ncr(n, c)});
    cout << total << "\n";

    return 0;
}
